shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English, used as a 'listen and find' game scene: the learner hears a sentence and taps the matching subject. Natural everyday photographic detail, natural light and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. Every subject named below must be instantly recognizable on a small phone screen. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

assets.item: It is eleven Park Street. / It is twelve Park Street. / It is fifteen Park Street. / It is twenty Park Street.
assets.prompt: A ROW OF FOUR TERRACED HOUSES along one cobbled street, photographed from across the street at a slight angle, so the four front doors appear side by side in one continuous brick facade. Each door is a different color (blue, green, red, yellow) and has one big brass house number on it: from left to right 11, 12, 15 and 20. The digits are large, clear and correct and are the ONLY writing anywhere: no street sign, no name plates, no letters. Evening light, lamps by the doors. No people. This is ONE single continuous photograph taken with one camera from one position: NOT a collage, NOT a grid, NOT side-by-side panels, no seams or dividing lines; the same ground and background run continuously behind every subject, and the subjects stand at slightly different distances from the camera like in a real scene.
